ai_summary.key_headline: Marsch's Vertical Gegenpress Meets Compact Qatari Low-Block

canada.philosophy: Aggressive high press and direct vertical attacking transitions.

qatar.philosophy: Compact defensive block springing direct counters through Akram Afif.

tactical_insights: With Alphonso Davies racing back from a hamstring injury, Tajon Buchanan carries Canada's main wide threat.
Juventus striker Jonathan David's clever movement will be vital to unlock Qatar's compact defensive block.
Lopetegui's Qatar will look to spring Akram Afif into the space behind Canada's aggressive high line.
